name: Ludus AI
tagline: AI agent for Unreal Engine — generate C++, Blueprints and 3D from prompts.
description: An AI toolkit that embeds directly inside Unreal Engine 5 to accelerate game development. From natural-language prompts it generates and explains C++ code, builds and analyzes Blueprints, produces textured 3D models, and answers context-aware questions about Unreal concepts. An agent mode can chain these into multi-step changes across a project.
insight: Founded by Piotr Penar, former CEO of game studio DreamStorm Studios, to put agentic AI natively inside Unreal Engine.
edge: Runs inside Unreal Engine 5 itself, generating C++, Blueprints and textured 3D models from prompts without leaving the editor.
pros: Native to the Unreal Engine 5 editor
cons: Unreal Engine only — no Unity or Godot

references.title: Ludus AI in Unreal Engine: Helpful Sidekick or Over-Hyped Hologram?
